body:
# convergent research

a sourced history of convergent research, the nonprofit that incubates focused research organizations, and its cofounders adam marblestone and anastasia gamick.

convergent research is the nonprofit that manufactures focused research organizations — philanthropic moonshot labs for science too big for one lab, too coordinated for a loose collaboration, and not profitable enough for a startup. adam marblestone and anastasia gamick founded it inside schmidt futures in 2021, incubating e11 bio and cultivarium; by 2026 the roster runs about a dozen fros — lean, [c]worthy, forest neurotech, dragonfly, meridial, echo labs — plus the gap map, a founder residency, and a blog that doubles as the model's press organ. this is the record of that bet — the thesis chapter, the day one memo, the launch, the cohort, the critiques, and whether philanthropic infrastructure can be a product.

- [history](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/history): the incubator, sourced and dated — the thesis chapter, the day one memo, the 2021 unveiling, the first cohort, and the federal turn.
  - [the missing middle gets a name](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/history#conception): 2019–2020 — rodriques' mit thesis writes the fro down first; the day one memo asks washington for sixteen of them.
  - [the incubator appears](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/history#founding): 2021 — marblestone and gamick found convergent inside schmidt futures; the october unveiling names e11 bio and cultivarium.
  - [the first cohort](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/history#portfolio): 2022–2023 — the nature comment, the tbi report, the $50m, and the 2023 wave that filled out the roster.
  - [the institutionalization](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/history#institutionalization): 2024–2025 — aria, the gap map, essential technology, the ai action plan, and the nsf tech labs rfi.
  - [the spread](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/history#expansion): 2026– — the first transition, mothra in nature, the uk cohort, and melody.
- [people](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/people): marblestone, gamick, rodriques, kalil, the board, the mission-control staff, and the fro founders — who they are and what they wrote.
  - [the co-founders](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/people#founder): marblestone and gamick — the boyden-lab scientist and the frontier-tech operator who proposed the incubator inside schmidt futures.
  - [the writing](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/people#writing): the thesis chapter, the day one memo, the nature comment, the field notes — the documents that carry the argument.
  - [the wider cast](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/people#team): rodriques the co-inventor, kalil the chair, the board, ~25 mission-control staff, and the people who run the fros.
  - [interviews and talks](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/people#appearances): the foresight sessions, the metascience keynote, and the podcasts where the model got said out loud.
  - [the philosophy](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/people#philosophy): the recurring themes — and the corrections: who founded what, and the quiet departures.
- [side quests](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/side-quests): the fro roster and the orbit around it — the subsidiaries, the incubator's own programs, the founders' other work, and the line beyond convergent.
  - [the fro roster](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/side-quests#fros): e11 bio through melody — the launched fros, including the first transition and the uk cohort.
  - [the incubator's own work](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/side-quests#programs): the gap map, essential technology, the uk founder residency, and the metascience alliance — the incubator's own work.
  - [the founders' and members' orbits](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/side-quests#orbits): marblestone's pre-convergent career, kalil's renaissance philanthropy, rodriques' futurehouse, gamick's fro board seats.
  - [the fro line beyond convergent](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/side-quests#ecosystem): rejuvenome, parpa→speculative technologies, bind, nsf tech labs, x-labs — the fro line beyond convergent.
- [coverage](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/coverage): what the discourse made of convergent — the launch press, the policy uptake, the funding headlines, the cohort's outputs, and the scene's critiques.
  - [the launch](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/coverage#launch): the fast company unveiling, the schmidt futures network, and the coordinated launch-week push.
  - [the policy uptake](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/coverage#policy): the nature manifesto, the tbi report, the ai action plan, and nsf tech labs — the model becoming policy.
  - [the funding headlines](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/coverage#funding): the $50m schmidt/griffin headline, the billionaire-science counterweight, and the uk cohort money.
  - [the fro cohort](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/coverage#fro-cohort): prism, plexdia, forest 1, the pharmome release, mothra — the coverage the fros earned.
  - [the scene's debate](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/coverage#scene): nintil, clancy, asparouhova, buck, reinhardt, mastroianni — the metascience scene's own debate.
  - [controversies](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/coverage#controversies): the schmidt question, the missing counterfactual, the licensing limits, the sunset walk-back, and the self-reported ledger.
  - [sentiment eras](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/coverage#eras): sentiment phases: wonkish origin → launch glow → money and scrutiny → first outputs → institutionalization → the spread.
- [the idea](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/the-idea): the fro as institutional technology — the lineage it inherited, what the model proved, what stayed unfinished, and who carries it next.
  - [lineage](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/the-idea#lineage): osrd and the program manager, the corporate labs, the philanthropic institutes, the megaprojects, and the science-reform wave.
  - [what convergent proved](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/the-idea#proved): fros can be built, the public goods ship, the vocabulary spread, and the incubator can be productized.
  - [what stayed unfinished](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/the-idea#stalled): the fundraising cap, midstream money, founder management, the untested endgame, and the missing counterfactual.
  - [the honest ledger](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/the-idea#debate): the for/against/nuance ledger — the honest arguments the coverage actually ran.
  - [successors](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/the-idea#successors): speculative technologies, astera, bind, futurehouse, renaissance, nsf tech labs, aria frost, x-labs, and the parallel cohort.
  - [open questions](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/the-idea#open-questions): the questions a next attempt has to answer.
- [sources](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/sources): every source cited in the convergent research history, with its date and type.
  - [the catalog](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/sources#catalog): the full typed catalog — primary, interview, reporting, archive, community, reference, repo.
- [method](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/method): how ai agents researched the convergent research history, the evidence rules they followed, and what they could not verify.
  - [the lanes](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/method#lanes): the two parallel research lanes and what the formula proved.
  - [the evidence rules](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/method#rules): the evidence model — confidence, precision, sentiment discipline.
  - [known gaps](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/method#gaps): what the research could not verify — recorded, not hidden.
  - [corrections](https://hraness.com/convergent-research/method#corrections): how to correct the record.
